basic_info.description: Step into 2538 Bryant, a stunning, full-floor condominium residence that seamlessly combines modern updates, soaring ceilings, charming period details, and expansive living spaces, all overlooking a lush and enchanting garden oasis. The light-filled living room is framed by bay windows and a charming fireplace with a stylish new tile surround. A formal dining room with original built-in cabinetry offers a warm and inviting space for large scale entertaining. The heart of the home is a recently renovated kitchen, a chef's dream, equipped with brand-new appliances, including a Thermador range, refrigerator and wine coolerand a large center island that's perfect for both meal prep and gathering. Just off the kitchen, a bright sunroom with walls of windows offers flexible space for dining, a home office, or both, with direct access to the garden ideal for al fresco grilling and dining with friends, casual get-togethers, or quiet afternoons. Other highlights include deeded independent parking, ample storage, and laundry. Situated near in the heart of the Mission and the vibrant 24th Street corridor, this home is close to popular destination restaurants, eateries, shops, BART, and local parksoffering the perfect mix of timeless character, thoughtful updates, and urban convenience
